jobs.title: Senior Environmental Scientist/Compliance Specialist (Remote)
jobs.description:
Discover your full potential. At Tetra Tech, we are collaborating with industry-leading experts for a sustainable future for our world. We combine consulting and engineering with advanced analytics and technology to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our innovation hubs across the globe will enable you to share ideas and best practices while growing your professional network. Wherever you are in your career journey, you will benefit from working with world-class engineers, scientists, and technical specialists.

At Tetra Tech, we are Leading with Science to solve the world’s most complex challenges. Our industry-leading experts in engineering and consulting are committed to driving positive change in communities around the world. For over 50 years, we have been at the forefront of innovation and sustainability. Today we stand as a market leader, offering cutting-edge solutions in water, environment, energy, and international development. Our work has improved more than 625 million lives around the world.

Join Tetra Tech to make a real difference. Our work leverages cutting-edge technologies, advanced analytics, and the expertise of world-class scientists and engineers to create meaningful change around the world. Discover your full potential – join us to advance your career while leaving a lasting legacy.

Apply today and join the company that is Leading with Science®.

Tetra Tech is seeking a self-motivated, experienced Environmental Scientist / Compliance Specialist to lead and expand our landfill and air quality compliance services within the solid waste industry. This position is ideal for candidates with a strong technical background in air regulations, Landfill Gas (LFG) systems, emissions compliance, environmental permitting, and regulatory interpretation, who are comfortable working with limited oversight while supporting complex, multi-site compliance programs.

In this role, you will independently manage and support regulatory compliance programs by analyzing complex field and operational datasets, interpreting and applying air quality regulations and permit requirements, preparing and reviewing compliance reports, and leading air permitting and emissions calculation efforts. The primary focus areas include LFG monitoring, Surface Emissions Monitoring (SEM), Landfill Gas‑to‑Energy (LFGTE) Systems, air quality permitting, and compliance with California Landfill Methane Regulation (LMR) requirements, New Source Performance Standards (NSPS), and National Emissions Standards for Hazardous Air Pollutants (NESHAP) applicable to solid waste facilities.

This position is primarily remote, with limited, as‑needed travel or occasional site visits. Candidates must be comfortable working independently, exercising professional judgment, and collaborating with project managers, field staff, engineers, clients, and regulatory specialists across geographically dispersed teams.

This position is eligible for our full benefits package including but not limited to Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, AD&D, Disability, Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Health Spending Account (HSA), My Flex Time (MFT – paid time off), 401K, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The pay range for this position is $90K–$110K annually, based on qualifications, location, and experience. Only those that attach a cover letter will be considered.
The deadline to apply is 11/11/2026.

Your Role

Independently review, analyze, interpret, and validate landfill air quality and LFG monitoring data, including wellfield data, SEM results, and air emissions datasets for multiple facilities.
Evaluate monitoring and operational data against regulatory standards, permit conditions, and LMR, NSPS, and NESHAP requirements, identifying compliance risks, deviations, and corrective action needs.
Prepare, review, and finalize environmental compliance reports, including air compliance summaries, annual and quarterly monitoring reports, deviation analyses, and regulatory submittals.
Lead the development and preparation of air quality permit applications, amendments, and renewals, including emissions calculations, regulatory applicability analyses, and compliance demonstrations.
Manage and oversee large, multi ‑ site datasets related to air emissions, LFG, SEM results, compliance schedules, and agency reporting deadlines.
Develop, maintain, and refine standardized templates, tools, and compliance trackers to ensure consistent, accurate, and timely reporting across multiple facilities and clients.
Coordinate closely with on ‑ site operations staff, technicians, contractors, and engineers to ensure monitoring programs, testing protocols, and system performance meet regulatory and permit requirements.
Serve as a technical resource to Project Managers and junior staff, supporting deliverables, schedules, quality control reviews, and client coordination.
Support client and agency interactions, including preparation for inspections, agency inquiries, and audit responses.
Contribute to and support multidisciplinary engineering, permitting, and environmental projects, providing subject ‑ matter expertise in landfill and air quality compliance.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in environmental science, air quality, regulatory compliance, or a related technical field.
Strong working knowledge of air quality regulations, including LMR, NSPS, NESHAP, and permit compliance applicable to landfills and solid waste facilities.
Demonstrated experience preparing and reviewing air permits, compliance reports, emissions calculations, and regulatory submittals.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including advanced technical and regulatory writing.
Proficiency in MS Office, specifically advanced use of Word and Excel for data analysis, tracking, and reporting.
Proven ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple projects concurrently, and exercise sound professional judgment with minimal supervision.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate effectively with clients, regulatory agencies, field staff, engineers, and multidisciplinary teams.
Valid driver’s license.
Ability and willingness to perform limited travel as required.
Demonstrated interest and capability in mentoring staff and developing leadership skills within the environmental compliance field.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, or a related discipline.
7+ years of experience supporting air quality and regulatory compliance for landfill or solid waste facilities.
In‑depth experience with: LFG systems, SEM, LFGTE systems.
Multi‑site compliance program management.
Experience working directly with regulatory agencies, responding to agency comments, inspections, or enforcement actions.
Familiarity with California and/or multi‑state air district permitting is a strong plus.
Experience supporting proposal development, scope development, or client growth initiatives.

Life At Tetra Tech

The perks of working at Tetra Tech include:

Comprehensive and market-competitive benefits.
Merit-based financial rewards.
Flexibility and company-wide commitment to work/life balance.
Collaborative team atmosphere that values the contributions of all employees.
Learning and development opportunities for ongoing professional growth.

About Tetra Tech

Tetra Tech is the leader in water, environment, and sustainable infrastructure, providing high-end consulting and engineering services for projects worldwide. With 25,000 employees working together, Tetra Tech provides clear solutions to complex problems by Leading with Science® to address the entire water cycle, protect and restore the environment, design sustainable and resilient infrastructure, and support the clean energy transition.

Tetra Tech
is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified candidates will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law. Tetra Tech is a VEVRAA federal contractor and we request priority referral of veterans.

We invite applications from all interested parties.

Explore our open positions at https://www.tetratech.com/careers. Follow us on social media to learn more about our people, culture, and opportunities:

LinkedIn: @TetraTechCareers

X (Twitter): @TetraTechJobs

We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

Please no phone calls or agencies.
